Technical Feedback
Thank you for reviewing the Multi-Phase Technical Methodology. Please use this Issue to address the sections relevant to your expertise.
1. Relevant Methodology Component
Please indicate the component(s) to which your feedback applies:
•	Data-Driven Inspection and Condition Monitoring 
•	Data Performance
•	Predictive Deterioration Modeling and Risk-Based Prioritization 
•	Standardized Lean Maintenance 
•	DOT Asset Management Integration 
•	Continuous Performance Monitoring and Multi-State Application 
•	Other 
2. Technical Observation or Issue
Please describe the specific technical issue, methodological limitation, assumption, practical constraint, or implementation challenge you have identified.
3. Technical or Practical Significance
Please explain why this issue is important and, where applicable, how it could affect infrastructure safety, reliability, lifecycle performance, data quality, model validity, maintenance decision-making, implementation, or scalability.
4. Recommended Improvement or Alternative Approach
If applicable, please describe a modification, alternative method, additional consideration, or implementation approach that could address the issue.
5. Supporting Basis
Where applicable, please identify the basis for your observation or recommendation, such as professional or field experience, engineering standards or specifications, transportation-agency practices, peer-reviewed research, technical reports, relevant data, or documented applications.
References or links may be included where appropriate.
6. Additional Comments
Please provide any additional information that may assist in evaluating or refining the methodology
